hints.title: Interval Bloom Invariant
hints.text: A flower is blooming at time t if and only if it started blooming <= t and has not yet finished blooming < t.

hints.title: Start and End Decomposition
hints.text: Separate flowers into sorted start times and sorted end times.

hints.title: Binary Search Difference
hints.text: At time t, blooming count = count(starts <= t) - count(ends < t).

hints.title: Bisect Bloom Evaluation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def fullBloomFlowers(self, flowers: list[list[int]], people: list[int]) -> list[int]:
        starts = sorted([s for s, e in flowers])
        ends = sorted([e for s, e in flowers])
        ans = []
        for t in people:
            started = bisect.bisect_right(starts, t)
            finished = bisect.bisect_left(ends, t)
            ans.append(started - finished)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Sorting flower events takes O(F log F), each person query takes O(log F).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all flowers for each person takes O(F * P) and TLEs for 5 * 10^4 each.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted start and end arrays take O(F) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms interval query into difference of two independent binary searches.
